notes: Shady Grove version: mirrors the College Park Management plan (mgmt-major); the requirements are identical, so the same plan is used. Its official flag and placeholder notes carry over below.

No Management-specific 4-year plan was reachable from the fetched source (the catalog's 'Catalog four-year plan' section only links to the Smith School's general roadmaps page and 4yearplans.umd.edu; the college's own general BS 'Typical Program' table stops after the sophomore year with no Management-specific courses placed). This plan is CONSTRUCTED from the catalog's own College Requirements and Management-major requirement tables; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Gen Ed slots are left out: only the major is audited.

Calculus gateway filled with MATH140 (Calculus I); Business Statistics gateway filled with BMGT230 (Business Statistics); Oral Communication filled with COMM107 (Oral Communication: Principles and Practices) -- all named directly in the catalog's own option lists, not invented.

The 12-credit 'select four of the following' elective is filled with BMGT360 (Strategic Management of Human Capital), BMGT366 (Growth Strategies for Emerging Companies), BMGT461 (Entrepreneurship), and BMGT463 (Cross-cultural Challenges in Business) -- four courses named directly in that slot's own catalog list, avoiding the catalog's unenforced 6-credit cap on BMGT468/BMGT469 entirely.

Course placement (year/term) is constructed, not sourced from a published plan: BMGT220/BMGT221 (Principles of Accounting I/II) placed sophomore year matching the college's own Freshman-Sophomore School Requirements grouping; BMGT362/BMGT363 (the major's two fixed courses) and the four management electives are placed junior/senior year, after their Freshman-Sophomore prerequisites-in-spirit, since the source gives no term-by-term sequencing for them.
